verdict: Live Planner decisions carried the contradiction forward, kept readiness scoped, and produced playable Quest and Boss experiences from academic plus explicit engagement evidence.

rounds.reason: Confirmed unassisted graded returned work (returned-work:e90798af16802de9659a) met the preregistered range for two of three constructs: equal_groups reached 1.00 (evaluation:cd58ac474b720927; observation:a1baa963489821c5, observation:0ce606204fe66767) and arrays reached 1.00 (evaluation:1b7d71227bc7fff2; observation:bb419afcaa82072d, observation:5ca99922d087d57e). Word-problem interpretation fell below the 0.70-1.00 range at 0.50 (evaluation:189974363295da63), with the exact preregistered error pattern - selecting addition instead of multiplication for an equal-groups story - observed at observation:1ccdf821e9d8f7f4 while observation:0892435956e407be was correct. This matches the revise criterion: returned work exposed a scoped error rather than contradicting transfer overall, so the theory is narrowed to a construct-specific interpretation gap rather than falsified or fully supported.

Confirmed unassisted graded returned work (returned-work:0031535d6995059f826e) split the theory. Word-problem interpretation met the preregistered range (evaluation:a27f078c804e15e1, observed 1.0 across observation:81c93f608540bf7b and observation:bbaf27b2c8a85202), but missing-factor fell far below range (evaluation:c8fdaacd3e1b0c13, observed 0.3333; failures at observation:0ee42baffce06546 and observation:4520f65725de1d50 with one success at observation:2aa76118c8657331) and equal sharing failed outright (evaluation:b81e075d2126c022, observed 0 at observation:d1b81984c24d6d80). The predicted error pattern — multiplying known numbers instead of solving for the missing group size or factor — was observed exactly, in both missing-factor and equal-sharing items, so the failure is a scoped, patterned unknown-position weakness rather than a global multiplication deficit. This satisfies the revise criteria (returned work exposes a scoped error) rather than blanket falsification, since one scoped construct transferred as predicted.

Confirmed unassisted graded returned work (returned-work:669be60869481a232004) supported three of four preregistered predictions at accuracy 1.0 within the 0.7-1.0 band: equal_groups (evaluation:86e6e05171057405, observation:d10841711c10da43, observation:c72a40b8f1c7c115), missing_factor (evaluation:40d7ae3df4699f1f, observation:49041448769f85c1), and word_problem_interpretation (evaluation:b2a57734e58c17cf, observation:1aefc03189d41337, observation:2502a56cc2b976a6, observation:59d86ebcaa44dfd2), with the predicted prior missing-factor and interpretation errors not recurring. The factor_pairs prediction missed its band (evaluation:69fa6e2c9629cc52, observation:18eacd211fb13b53; observed 0 vs min 0.7, prediction error 0.7), and the single observed error matched the preregistered pattern of an incomplete response when multiple factor pairs are requested. This is a scoped error on one construct rather than repeated contradiction across constructs, so the theory is revised rather than falsified. The single factor_pairs item is also too thin to distinguish a stable gap from a one-item slip, so mastery is not asserted from the three supported predictions alone.
